lee_design: quick sync on p95 card tweaks. seeing confusion: label 'window' being read as global time window. lee_design: suggestion: change label to 'aggregation window' + small info icon with hover text: 'Bucket size used to compute percentiles across traces.' comp uploaded to figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz987 ashley_eng: fine with label change. alerting queries still reference `rollup_window` though. prefer we only change UI text. lee_design: agreed backend param stays `rollup_window`, only UI label flips. will add docs note. priya_pm: UX idea: show a one-time coach mark for new users explaining aggregation vs time range. copy: 'Aggregation window: bucket size used to compute percentiles.' maria_g: accessibility nits: the info icon at 12px fails contrast, needs >4.5:1. and the icon must be keyboard focusable with visible outline. tooltip should be aria-describedby, not just title attr. samir: also add an aria-label on the chart, e.g. 'Latency (p95) over time aggregation 30s'. tab order should be predictable: timepicker presets sampling toggle. ashley_eng: implementation: sampling toggle state currently global. do we want per-panel? i propose per-panel in localStorage: `redwood.latency.panel.{panelId}.sampling`. easy to implement; enterprise can request server-side later. lee_design: per-panel makes sense to allow different dashboards to show different sampling. UI: when sampling enabled show a badge like 'sampling: 10%' with hover explaining impact on p95 accuracy. priya_pm: analytics/devs: log events on changes: `latency.window.change` and `latency.sampling.change` with props panel_id, old, new. maria_g: microcopy tweak: change '95th percentile latency' -> 'Latency at the 95th percentile' for clearer SR output. lee_design: proposed accessible tooltip markup: ``` Aggregation window
Bucket size used to compute percentiles across traces.
``` ashley_eng: will add aria-describedby, make icon focusable, and add test for keyboard focus + tooltip. will namespace localStorage keys. samir: one follow-up: if aggregation window <10s show inline warning 'low window may produce noisy percentiles' with learn-more link. can be follow-up. uxbot: created task INFR-3421 and attached figma https://figma.com/file/xyz987?node-id=21 lee_design: cool. action items: lee update figma/copy; ashley add aria + storage + tests; priya add analytics + docs; maria confirm contrast + focus; samir draft aria examples. sync tomorrow 11am. :thumbsup:
